title: agents-md-compiler bundle lock, format version 1
description: Deterministic lock recording exact source identity. Serialized with sorted keys, two-space indentation, ASCII escaping, LF line endings, and one final LF. Contains identity only, never source content.

bundle_id.description: Bundle identifier copied from the manifest.

manifest_sha256.description: Digest of the exact manifest file bytes. Any manifest edit, including a comment, changes it and makes the lock stale.

modules.description: Locked modules in manifest order. Order is semantic and is preserved even though object keys are sorted.

resolved_source.description: Absolute resolved source path at lock time.

sha256.description: Digest of the canonical source bytes.

size_bytes.description: Canonical source byte count. A source is never empty.
